title: Measure Petclinic cold and exact reruns from original sources
description: Run the three frozen JDK 17 deployments in fresh verifier processes for a cold baseline, exact rerun and clean comparison. Resolve the original Maven graph and compile all sources even on a hit. Re-execute failed startup and compare all observed effects, intents, execution bindings and input scopes to clean, including the unchanged-source compiler outcome.
expected: All deployment outcomes match at unchanged scope, and exact positive reuse and repeated failed starts have measured total CPU, RSS and wall cost.

steps.name: Rebuild and compare all three whole-workflow passes
